infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera is used to scan QR codes on trucks for driver registration and mission assignment.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: PulseTrack needs your location to track fleet movements, provide route information, and send real-time speed/location data to fleet managers.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PulseTrack needs your location while the app is open to track your driving route.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: PulseTrack needs background location to continue tracking fleet movements even when the app is in the background.
